qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: J2 Gigabit Ethernet names a source-specific physical communications interface, not an independently network-addressable participant.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No IP address, service endpoint, registered node, or observed connectivity.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: The J2-to-platform Ethernet channel is an optional conditional physical sensor/host interface.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No installed cable, separate connected device, or tested external connection.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Two current Edition1.1 numbered SHALL Rules have Inspection (I) methods and apply specifically to J2 Ethernet signals.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not adopted DIM or CSAPI Profile universal requirements.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: An eight-wire/four-pair 100-ohm Gigabit physical link can underlie network communications.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not an ISA Controller/Client network instance or service discovery.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: 1000BaseT and CAT 6A describe physical channel/cable standards.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not digital message-encoding or data-model version negotiation.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: J2 Ethernet signals must implement Gigabit Ethernet and the cited physical channel and cabling conditions.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Condition applies to J2 interface, not every whole sensing system or software service.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: C239 declares a particular physical Ethernet interface implementation for J2 hardware.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not evidence of a live offered or activated capability.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: 100 Ω is a source-descriptive physical link characteristic with four twisted pairs.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not a generic allowed-value schema for sensing data or a measured channel impedance.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Original IEEE/cable compliance is a physical design claim and connector context.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not a measured installed configuration or live interface state.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: A designed 1000BaseT J2 channel could carry traffic, but no source case uses it in the examined evidence.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No established actual reporting route, observed Ethernet traffic, or online device.

exact_holds.description: Original IEEE 802.3-2008 normative clauses and requirements were not independently examined; C239 pointer is not an IEEE audit.
Original AS6070/6 CAT 6A cable standard is unexamined; no vendor wiring claims inferred.
C239 allows CAT 6A AS6070/6 or equivalent, but what establishes equivalent cable is not verified here.
The descriptive 100 Ω, eight-wire/four-pair physical channel is not measured on any real sensor or platform.
Previous six-page J2 pinout graphic and modality tick matrix remain pixel-unverified; 1000BaseT electrical pairs are not a verified pin-geometry drawing.
An Ethernet physical channel does not establish address allocation, IP connectivity, discovered service, CSAPI resource or reporting path.
Physical J2 Ethernet requirements are conditional on the particular hardware class/interface, not mandatory on all sensors described by the DIM.
The cited 2008 IEEE edition is preserved literally; current revisions or supersession are not presumed or imported.
No four empirical source equipment cases document this exact SOSA J2 connector or proven Gigabit Ethernet link.
Original eight C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI companion files, later S251 2025 and restricted Appendix C remain unexamined.
No independent hardware, live traffic capture, conformance test or DIM/CSAPI Profile adoption occurred.
